# Troubleshooting / FAQ
## Labels not appearing
Q: I can't see labels on the ribbon bar in the desktop applications, why?
A: This could be a few things: give labels more time if deployed recently, ensure your apps are up to date, and check the web versions. If none of these resolve the issues, reach out to the contact below for assistance.

## Label priority
Q: Does it matter if I go from Confidential to External?
A: Yes. Since Confidential is a higher priority than External, you will need to provide a justification as to why. A box will appear asking for the reason. Some options are: the label no longer applies, the label was incorrect, or a custom explanation in the text box.

## External sharing
Q: How do recipients view items labeled Confidential?
A: Their experience differs depending on what tools they use. It will be seamless if they are using Microsoft applications. Third-party applications such as Google or personal email will have them sign in using a web portal which will be linked in an email sent to them.
